taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said what is expected of you is unclear. What is happening?

Aiyoh, being week 3 here already, today my bus from Butterworth jammed and came so late lah, rush all the way here only to freeze because the office aircon is like Genting Highlands, super cold until my fingers stiff already! Plus last week my SAP access also approved damn late, wasting so much time, and you know my team lead right, always stuck in endless client calls, cannot even catch him to ask anything properly. Plus the daily processing quota here is so high, running chasing numbers non-stop, but good thing downstairs canteen the nasi lemak sambal is quite sedap lah, can makan to cure sadness a bit. But honestly lah, the main headache is nobody actually bothered to brief me properly on the specific vendor master rules, so now every time I process blindly and half my invoices kena rejected by the system, meaning I have to waste so much time redoing everything from scratch, blur like sotong already and really don't know what management expects!
What would help you understand those vendor master rules better?

Aiyoh, honestly if someone can just sit down with me for like half an hour and share a cheat sheet or standard SOP document lah, that would damn shiok already! Right now I blur like sotong trying to guess tax codes, and every time invoices kena reject my heart pain one, especially with this crazy high quota and my lead stuck in meetings all day. Even yesterday my senior colleague also rushing month-end closing, so nobody got time to entertain me properly. If finance team can just provide a proper vendor master cheat sheet—like knowing which supplier actually needs special PO references—then at least I won't keep wasting hours redoing everything from scratch, right? Plus after settling all that, we can all go down canteen tapau some teh tarik and nice nasi lemak together to cure the Monday blues lah! Really need some proper guidance fast before I go crazy looking at this SAP screen.

Here is what I will tell HR: The new hire experienced unclear expectations, lack of supervisor availability, missing training on vendor rules, and high processing quotas. [ROLE_CLARITY, MANAGER_SUPPORT, ONBOARDING_TRAINING, WORKLOAD] "nobody actually bothered to brief me properly on the specific vendor master rules, so now every time I process blindly and half my invoices kena rejected by the system, meaning I have to waste so much time redoing everything from scratch, blur like sotong already and really don't know what management expects!"
